_comment: Remington's cron routines for agentId 'pm'. STAGED DISABLED (enabled:false) until (a) the pm agent exists in openclaw.json, (b) the Atlassian token is in the gateway env so pm/trinity tools authenticate, and (c) Slack channel IDs are filled into each delivery.to + message. Flip enabled:true per job once verified. Merge these into ~/.openclaw/cron/jobs.json (or import via the openclaw cron CLI). Times are America/New_York per ROUTINES.md.

jobs.name: sla-sweep
jobs.description: Hourly SLA sweep (QA stalled / Pending-Approval / Blocked / Changes-Requested), business hours

payload.message: Run the SLA sweep. Read tasks/sla-sweep.md and execute it: read the `sla` block from STATE.md, call pm.sla_check(prior_state=<that block>), post any alerts_to_send to the SLA channels, and write the returned state back to STATE.md. Obey the self-loop guard and the write-gate (Jira @-mention escalations are proposed, not auto-fired). If there are zero new alerts, stay silent.

Run the daily standup. Read tasks/standup.md and execute it: pass STATE.md (at least the `sla` and `action_items` blocks) into pm.standup(prior_state=...), compose the 7-part digest plus daily priorities, post it to #ecd-standup, and write the returned state back. Any DoR nudges that post to Jira go through the write-gate (propose first). Close the loop on yesterday's action_items.

Run blocked-ticket analysis. Read tasks/blocked-analysis.md and execute it: read the `blocked` block from STATE.md, call pm.blocked_analysis(prior_state=<that block>), triage the returned comment threads yourself (still-blocked / resumed / response-needed), post the digest to #blocked-tickets, and write state back. Any Jira comment goes through the write-gate.

jobs.name: timesheet
jobs.description: Weekly timesheet/worklog: hours vs estimates, over-estimate flags

payload.message: Run the weekly timesheet report. Read tasks/timesheet.md and execute it: call pm.timesheet(week_offset=0) for last complete week, format the per-developer hours-vs-estimate digest, and post to #timesheets.

jobs.name: portfolio-audit
jobs.description: Weekly portfolio health: 7 initiative/epic hygiene signals

payload.message: Run the portfolio health audit. Read tasks/portfolio-audit.md and execute it: read the `initiatives` block from STATE.md, call pm.portfolio_audit(prior_state=<that block>), post the findings + trend to #portfolio-health, and write state back.

jobs.name: pm-self-audit
jobs.description: Weekly PM self-audit scorecard (approximates sprint-close); feeds reflection

payload.message: Run the PM self-audit. Read tasks/pm-self-audit.md and execute it: call pm.pm_audit(pm_account_id=<Remington's/PM accountId>) for the active sprint, record the scorecard in the `self_audit` STATE.md block, and post a brief self-assessment to #pm-agent-logs. This feeds the weekly reflection. NOTE: schedule approximates sprint-close via Friday 16:00 — revisit once a real sprint-close trigger exists.

Run housekeeping. Read tasks/db-cleanup.md and execute it. In the OpenClaw world most old DB retention is obsolete (state lives in STATE.md); prune STATE.md of resolved entries and trim episodic memory if needed. Stay silent unless something needed attention.
